Battle of Krivaja
Battle of Krivaja was a battle during operation "Sword and Shield" codename for the military offensive conducted by the special Krajina Corps of the VRS in September 1995 in Bosanska Krajina. The objective of the offensive was the breaking of the 5th Corps and the conquest of Bosanska Krajina, and to kill 30,000 Bosniak men. The offensive ended in VRS defeat with the ARBiH recapturing lost teritory near Cazin from Serbs. The Serbs suffered an atrocious defeat and high casualties while fighting Bosniak ambushes in Krivaja which forced them to retreat from Krivaja and retreat from Cazin. This battle prevented VRS from capturing Cazin, Serbian forces prepared an offensive with 40 tanks t84 but they had to retreat to starting positions while losing lots of military equipment.This represents the end of the serbian operation "Sprzena zemlja".
